title: Pistachio Latte Creamer Recipe
description: Pistachio latte creamer is a flavored coffee creamer that adds a nutty, sweet taste of pistachio to your coffee or lattes. Typically, it’s a creamy blend made from dairy or plant-based ingredients, sweeteners, and natural or artificial pistachio flavoring. It’s perfect for enhancing your morning coffee or espresso drinks, offering a unique twist compared to traditional creamers.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk (for vegan options, use coconut condensed milk)
Optional: 2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey for added sweetness
instructions:
1. Start by soaking the raw pistachios in hot water for about 30 minutes to soften them. This process makes the nuts easier to blend and ensures that their flavor is mellow and creamy.
  2. Drain the pistachios and add them to a blender along with 2 cups of fresh water. Blend on high until the mixture becomes very smooth. This could take around 1-2 minutes depending on the potency of your blender.
  3. Place a nut milk bag or a fine mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth over a large bowl. Pour the blended pistachio mixture through the strainer. Use a spoon or your hands to press all the liquid out. The goal is to extract as much pistachio milk as possible.
  4. Return the strained pistachio milk to the blender. Add the sweetened condensed milk, almond extract, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt. If you prefer your creamer a bit sweeter, this is the time to add maple syrup or honey. Blend again until all the components are well combined and the mixture is smooth.
  5. Pour your homemade Pistachio Latte Creamer into a clean glass bottle or a jar. Seal tightly and store in the refrigerator for up to a week.
notes:
• Quality of Ingredients: Use high-quality fresh pistachios for the best flavor. Stale nuts can give your creamer a rancid taste.
  • Blending: Make sure to blend the mixture until very smooth. The creaminess of your creamer depends heavily on how well the pistachios are blended.
  • Customization: Adjust the thickness of your creamer by playing with the amount of water used. Less water produces a thicker creamer, while more water will thin it out.
  • Shake Before Use: Ingredients may separate slightly when stored, so always give your creamer a good shake before adding it to your coffee.
  • Serving Suggestion: Mix this pistachio creamer into hot or iced coffee. You can also try it in teas or baked goods for a touch of pistachio flavor.
